title: Experts at CII meet flag roadblocks in Kashmir apple cart’s global ambition
content: Kashmir has a small four-month window for exporting apples and the cold chain is still poor at maintaining the quality, said  Dr. N.K. Krishna Kumar, ex-Deputy Director (Horticulture) Indian Council of Agricultural Research

title: Supreme Court strikes down Karnataka law validating ‘corrupt’ 2011 recruitment

title: NoRKA Care enrolment portal launched for Non-Resident Keralites
content: Existing members can renew their health and accident insurance policies, while new applicants can register for the scheme until November 30, 2026; the web portal and the updated mobile application allow NRKs from anywhere in the world to enrol in the scheme and access its services online

title: Supreme Court calls for financial institutions to compensate digital arrest victims
content: The Bench stressed that the proposed regulatory framework must provide for suitable compensation to victims where financial institutions are found to have failed in their due diligence obligations

title: A.P. power infra loss estimated at ₹500-crore; restoration works complete in 4,765 Arnab-hit villages
content: Inspecting the cyclone-hit areas, Gottipati Ravi Kumar says government has intensified emergency repairs to the damaged infrastructure, with special focus on Palakollu, Bhimavaram and Narsapur, which bore the brunt of the extreme weather event

title: Government to evaluate impact of guarantee and other schemes
content: Titled ‘Project K-Monitor’, the evaluation process will be taken up across all Assembly constituencies of the State

title: KSEB receives nod for short-term power purchases for November 2026-March 2027 period
content: KSERC has cleared a total procurement of 145 megawatt (MW) for November and 120 MW for December 2026, 240 MW each for January and February 2027, and 270 MW for March 2027

title: 5 compulsory subjects, optional skill paper as safety net: CBSE scheme for 2028 Class 10 exams
content: The clarification applies specifically to students studying in Class 9 in 2026-27, who will appear for their Class 10 board examination in 2028. It does not affect the current Class 10 batch

title: Private bus owners’ hunger strike in Keralam to enter 4th day on Oct. 30; agitation to expand to other districts
content: The hunger strike is being held to press for several demands, including the protection of the private bus industry impacted by the KSRTC free travel scheme

title: Maharashtra MLC polls: Blame game begins in Mahayuti as BJP points fingers at Shiv Sena for defeat
content: Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde said that the Shiv Sena had always abided by alliance dharma; CM Fadnavis shares stage with Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray at a function sparking political buzz; BJP calls Sena ‘greedy’ while Sena blames BJP for unfair seat distribution in the polls

title: Why public intellectuals matter in present-day India
content: A public intellectual raises questions about the social, political and economic issues of the day using reasoned arguments; the growing assertion of authoritarian tendencies, destruction of democratic practices and criminalisation of dissent make their role more crucial in the present times

title: At BRICS, India must bank on the NDB
content: India should use BRICS to maximise the grouping’s potential without strengthening Beijing, with the New Development Bank offering a practical avenue for cooperation; strengthening the NDB through greater capital, membership and local-currency lending can make BRICS more relevant

title: Clash on campus: police keep vigil in Calicut University in Keralam; classes suspended
content: Around 30 students were injured in a clash between SFI and UDSF activists during the counting of votes for the campus students’ union polls

content: In a notification issued on Thursday, B-SMILE says the two tenders have been cancelled due to technical reasons, as instructed by the Urban Development Department, which is the competent authority

title: Amid objections from Opposition LDF and G. Sudhakaran, Keralam Assembly passes SARAL Bill
content: The Bill has the stated aim of ensuring timely issuance of licences and permits for industrial ventures. Independent MLA Sudhakaran, backed by the UDF, says Bill could lead to large-scale destruction of paddy fields, wetlands and forestland. Pinarayi says Bill is trying to create a parallel system to the existing single window system. Industries Minister says it is only meant to speed up the process to give clearances

title: Turning job loss into opportunity: Ex-staff of CorroHealth to launch cooperative venture in Keralam
content: Inspired by the history of Indian Coffee House, the technology enterprise owned and operated by the professionals who work in it will focus on health-care IT and medical coding

title: Days after Theni jailbreak, Tamil Nadu Prisons DGP Sandeep Rai Rathore transferred
content: 17 remand prisoners who were lodged at the Thekkampatti sub-jail near Andipatti in Theni district escaped on October 26 and were later recaptured by special teams over the next two days.

title: Food Safety officials conduct State-wide inspection at 45 packaged drinking water units; notices issued to 24
content: 32 water samples sent for testing; misbranded water seized in Mysuru and Davangere; a unit in Mulbagal shut down

title: Sada ‘Master’, ace guitarist who enriched Ilaiyaraaja’s compositions, dies at 80
content: “I am saddened by Sadanandam’s death. He was with me from the early days,” Ilaiyaraaja said in a message

title: Syria says French jihadist killed in shootout with government forces
content: In a statement carried by state television, security forces in Idlib said a patrol observed ‘an armed group leaving the French camp... in violation of the agreement that prohibits exiting [the site] with weapons’

title: Fishing boat catches fire near Feroke
content: The incident, which occurred when workers were away from the spot, reportedly originated in the boat’s engine and fuel tank

title: 'Don't push us': SC warns of harsh stand on firecrackers if orders go unenforced
content: The Supreme Court tackled the persistent air pollution crisis in Delhi-NCR, stressing the importance of adhering to current firecracker laws. Authorities were cautioned against inaction, as deteriorating air quality poses a threat to public health. The bench underlined the necessity for collaboration among all parties to effectively manage firecracker usage. Measures taken by the Delhi government include restrictions on older vehicles and staggered work hours.

title: US declares national emergency in 13 states to secure power grid; what it means
content: US government has declared a national emergency to address security risks posed by foreign-made electricity equipment. An executive order has been signed, allowing tighter restrictions on potentially dangerous foreign equipment. The new measures aim to protect the national grid from cyberattacks and supply disruptions. This initiative could also boost domestic manufacturers as reliance on potentially vulnerable foreign suppliers is reduced.

title: US intelligence confirms image shows China's secret spaceplane in orbit
content: The US Defense Intelligence Agency has unveiled a detailed satellite image showcasing China's experimental reusable spaceplane currently in orbit. This vehicle exhibits design traits reminiscent of the US Space Force's X-37B, indicating active engagement in diverse orbital tasks. Following its recent fourth mission, apprehensions regarding its military function and potential have surged.

title: Texas homeowners now own park, roads and ponds after decade-long legal fight
content: In a significant turn of events, residents of La Bota Ranch in Laredo officially gained control over common property areas after a protracted legal battle. This shift follows a jury's March 2022 decision that found developers had breached fiduciary duties, prompting residents to reevaluate governance due to rising association fees. The final handover on August 20, 2026, empowers homeowners over shared facilities, symbolizing a hard-won victory for community representation.

title: Von der Leyen proposes associate membership for Ottawa
content: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen's recent proposal for an associate membership with Canada seeks to bolster collaboration without full EU membership. This initiative dovetails with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's strategy to broaden trade relations with Europe. Together, both parties aim to fortify economic partnerships and jointly innovate in sectors like artificial intelligence and supercomputing, consequently navigating shared interests and global challenges.

title: 3,106-carat Cullinan diamond became 530-carat gem in British royal sceptre
content: Frederick Wells discovered the enormous Cullinan diamond in South Africa in 1905 while working at the Premier Mine. Its exceptional size caught public attention, leading to its purchase by the Transvaal government for King Edward VII. The diamond was carefully cut into several gemstones over eight months, resulting in noteworthy pieces for the British royal collection. Following Edward VII's death, the largest stone was incorporated into the Sovereign's Sceptre.

title: Indianapolis charity goes from $9,000 start to 175,000 bouquets for patients
content: Random Acts of Flowers Indianapolis marked ten years of service, delivering its 175,000th flower arrangement to Eskenazi Health. This charity reuses donated flowers to create arrangements for hospital patients in need. Volunteers collect flowers from various local sources to prevent waste and support emotional well-being. The organization was founded after a successful fundraising effort in 2016. It aims to continue its work through community partnerships and ongoing donations.

title: Michael Dell hails Trump Accounts as donor push grows
content: Michael Dell has endorsed the Trump Accounts initiative, which aims to provide American children with stock market investments. The program has opened approximately 9 million accounts for children under 18 and further plans to create accounts for all 70 million eligible kids. High-profile donors, including Gwynne Shotwell and Ray Dalio, are contributing funds to expand its reach.

title: Bird-like dinosaur may be first known fruit-eating specialist, study finds
content: Scientists have recently uncovered a small dinosaur named Infernogallus jamesi, believed to have predominantly dined on fruit. By examining its skull and jaw muscles, researchers gained insights into its dietary habits. Existing during the Cretaceous period, as flowering plants flourished, this dinosaur displays anatomical traits akin to modern fruit-feeding parrots, deepening our comprehension of the varied lifestyles in the era of dinosaurs.

title: XUV700 booked in 2022, never delivered: Mahindra ordered to refund and pay Rs 62k
content: A consumer in Haryana sought redress after Mahindra & Mahindra failed to deliver a booked SUV. The booking was made in February 2022, but the vehicle was never delivered to the customer. The manufacturer and dealer provided contradictory claims regarding the situation surrounding the delayed delivery. Consequently, the consumer commission found both parties guilty of unfair trade practices and ordered compensation.

title: Mississippi court backs father's deed giving family land to wife over children
content: A Mississippi father left his family home and 0.86 acres of land equally to his three children in a 2008 will but transferred the property to his wife in 2021. After his death, his daughter challenged the transfer, claiming he had been improperly influenced due to his declining health. On Tuesday, an appeals court rejected her challenge, finding insufficient evidence of undue influence.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ retirement timeline: Chiefs trainer reveals his 10 Super Bowl goal
content: Patrick Mahomes wants to win 10 Super Bowls before considering retirement, according to his longtime trainer Jeff Christensen. The trainer recalled hearing that goal when Mahomes was a rookie in 2017 and believes the quarterback remains focused on greatness rather than money. Mahomes has already won three Super Bowls with Kansas City, but he has not announced when he plans to retire.

title: Leon Draisaitl turns 31: Why Celeste Desjardins called it “your year, baby”
content: Celeste Desjardins celebrated Leon Draisaitl’s 31st birthday with heartfelt Instagram Stories featuring personal videos, a childhood hockey photo, and memories from their relationship, and her message, “This is your year baby!!!,” stood out among the tributes to the Edmonton Oilers forward. The celebration came as Draisaitl continued to deliver strong offensive numbers early in the 2026–27 NHL season.

title: California couple wins garden rights after neighbour’s 1955 deal for $250
content: A California couple who bought a home in 2019 found themselves in a legal battle after their neighbour claimed ownership of a 20-by-20-foot garden they believed was theirs. The dispute centred on a 1955 agreement involving $250, babysitting services and land access rights. On Monday, a California appeals court upheld the couple's exclusive right to use the garden.

title: Jason Statham's £20m estate faces planning scrutiny over summerhouse
content: Jason Statham and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley are facing challenges in planning the summerhouse at their Hampshire estate. They have submitted a request for a certificate of lawfulness to transform the structure, initially approved as a swimming-pool pavilion, into residential quarters. Although the summerhouse has served as guest accommodation for prior owners since 2012, the New Forest National Park Authority is currently assessing the appropriateness of their application.

title: 'This is not a drama': Israeli agency had illegal funds intel; didn't share info
content: The inquiry follows an order from Central Elections Committee (CEC) chairman Justice Noam Sohlberg, who received information from Shin Bet chief David Zini describing the suspicions as “extraordinary in its seriousness”. Qatar, however, has categorically denied interfering in Israel’s elections. Meanwhile, the investigation is not expected to delay the announcement of final results or prevent President Isaac Herzog from asking a party leader to begin forming a coalition.

title: She fasted for husband's long life on Karwa Chauth, he kills her with pestle
content: In a tragic turn of events, Anand allegedly took the life of his wife Madhu during a domestic quarrel at their Gwalior residence on Karwa Chauth. The incident occurred while Madhu was observing her fast, resulting in her immediate death. Their children were present during the ordeal, yet family members did not hear any commotion.

title: Florida court reverses HOA auction cancellation made without hearing buyer
content: A Florida homeowner paid his outstanding homeowners' association fees five days after his property was sold at a foreclosure auction in October 2024. The sale was subsequently cancelled, but the winning bidder challenged the decision, saying it had not been heard. Nearly two years later, a Florida appeals court overturned the cancellation and ordered a fresh hearing.

title: 'Football belongs to the fans': Ronaldo reacts after winning Ballon d’Or of All Time
content: Cristiano Ronaldo thanked fans for recognizing his phenomenal 2008 season as the greatest, where he led Manchester United to clinch both the Premier League and UEFA Champions League titles. At just 23, he netted 42 goals, solidifying his reputation as a top player. In a fan-voted poll for the Ballon d'Or of All Time, Lionel Messi's legendary 2012 season came in second place, alongside other historic performances from football greats.

title: Connor Hellebuyck trade: Why did the New Jersey Devils make a puzzling move?
content: The New Jersey Devils drew attention after Connor Hellebuyck was left out of the lineup for their game against the Colorado Avalanche, just one game after his debut with the team. Jake Allen started, while Rémi Poirier served as backup. With no official explanation provided, questions remain over whether Hellebuyck’s absence was routine workload management or related to another undisclosed consideration.

title: World War bombs still haunt Europe as Italy finds 250 munitions in melting glaciers
content: The melting glaciers of Italy's Dolomites are revealing World War I unexploded munitions, drawing attention to a significant European concern as similar remnants emerge across the continent. Countries like Belgium, Germany, and France also grapple with hazards posed by unexploded ordnance during construction and environmental changes. In a notable operation, Italian forces recovered over 250 munitions, underscoring the lasting threat of wartime relics in modern Europe.

title: Watch: Irritated by parking sensor noise, man sets neighbour’s car on fire
content: A local youth, identified as Shikhar Gohel, was booked for allegedly igniting a neighbor's car in Morbi. The incident occurred after an ongoing parking dispute between Gohel and the car's owner, Pushpa Bhatt. Gohel reportedly got irritated by the sensor noise emitted from Bhatt's vehicle. CCTV footage captured him pouring flammable liquid and setting the car ablaze before fleeing the scene. Significant damage, estimated at Rs 3.

title: Minecraft creator lists $70m mansion for same price he paid 12 years ago
content: Markus 'Notch' Persson has placed his Beverly Hills mansion on the market for $70 million. He purchased the estate in 2014 after outbidding Beyoncé and Jay-Z, who also showed interest. The mansion features eight bedrooms, a nightclub, and a professional recording studio for entertainment. The billionaire decided to sell as he spends less time in Los Angeles these days.

title: Baby gorilla Bili rescued from traffickers begins new life at Congo sanctuary
content: Bili, the young gorilla saved from wildlife trafficking in Nigeria, has embarked on a fresh journey in the Republic of the Congo. After three years of dedicated care and rehabilitation, she is now set for a quarantine period at the Tchimpounga Nature Reserve. Here, Bili will undergo health assessments and prepare for her introduction to fellow gorillas, with hopes of eventually reintegrating her into the wild.

title: 'Did you put pumpkin in khichdi?' Richa Chadha on Ali Fazal's parenting
content: Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal reflect on their parenting experiences and how they manage childcare responsibilities. Ali's involvement includes asking detailed questions about their daughter's meals while working away. Richa appreciates his care but sometimes feels it borders on micromanagement. They aim to balance their professional commitments with family needs and prioritize clear communication. Their story highlights the dynamics of modern parenting and the importance of trust.

title: IndiGo CEO says ‘no choice’ but to consider fare hikes as fuel costs surge
content: IndiGo's CEO Willie Walsh has indicated that ticket prices may soon rise as the airline grapples with soaring fuel costs, which have climbed by 67.2 percent compared to last year. Despite facing substantial challenges, with a net loss of Rs 1,879.1 crore for the September quarter, Walsh emphasizes the importance of cutting expenses and maintaining operational efficiency to manage these rising costs successfully.

title: Patrick Mahomes vs Micah Parsons: Why ACL recovery timelines differ
content: Micah Parsons had a full meniscus repair, which takes longer to recover from. For eight weeks, he was not allowed to bend his knee fully and used support to walk. Patrick Mahomes underwent immediate surgery because he also suffered an LCL tear, leading to a quicker recovery and rehabilitation timeline for the Kansas City Chiefs QB.

title: Why markets rallied: Sensex jumps over 900 points, Nifty gains 1 per cent; 5 key reasons
content: Indian stock markets rallied sharply on Thursday, with the Sensex rising over 900 points to close at 74,151. The Nifty gained more than 1%, settling at 22,936.75, supported by positive corporate earnings and a firmer rupee. Crude oil prices eased slightly, providing relief to oil-importing India amid high inflation concerns. A broad-based buying interest was noted across sectors, particularly in realty and FMCG.

title: Karnataka hikes milk prices by Rs 8 per litre from Nov 1
content: The Karnataka Cabinet has sanctioned an increase in milk prices by Rs 8 per litre, set to commence on November 1. This adjustment will grant farmers an additional Rs 7 per litre, while cooperatives will benefit from Re 1. Farmers, who currently earn Rs 35 per litre, will see their income boosted to Rs 42.

title: Why Apple took 16 years to make a touchscreen MacBook
content: In 2010, Steve Jobs called touchscreen laptops ergonomically terrible, and Apple spent the next 16 years agreeing with him. The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display ends that run, and its OLED panel is what made touch possible. Jobs would probably still complain about tired arms. He would also likely recognise the move, because his no was usually aimed at ideas Apple couldn’t yet do well.

title: Josh Inglis becomes first Australian cricketer to achieve this rare feat in all three formats
content: In a remarkable comeback to Test cricket, Josh Inglis achieved his second century, scoring 102 runs, as Australia triumphed with a total of 429 runs against South Africa. This impressive performance marked him as the first Australian player to secure multiple centuries across all formats. Alongside Inglis, Alex Carey shone brightly with an important contribution of 80 runs, leading Australia to a 100-run advantage after dismissing South Africa for 329.

title: Texas court scraps $796,906 award in grandmother's diamond and cash dispute
content: A Texas grandmother's safe-deposit box became the centre of a family dispute after her death in 2019. Her grandson reported finding $16,000, while another family member claimed it contained $400,000, an eight-carat diamond ring and gold coins. The grandmother's niece later won nearly $797,000 in damages, but an appeals court overturned the award on Tuesday, citing her failure to follow the required legal process.

title: MLC polls: BJP wins big, but Congress & SP send a message from Nagpur, Varanasi
content: While the BJP-led NDA won big in the MLC elections across four states, it suffered setbacks in two politically significant constituencies: Nagpur and Varanasi where the Congress and SP held their ground.

title: It only takes one rumour: How a small trigger can lead to a deadly stampede
content: On October 17, a tragic stampede in Kolkata claimed 19 lives during the Durga Puja celebrations. The incident was caused by overcrowding, panic, and a misleading announcement about structural failure. Experts emphasize the importance of effective crowd management to prevent similar tragedies in the future. Investigators are examining various factors contributing to the disaster, including narrow exits and inadequate safety measures.

title: Nvidia CEO Was China Spy Target, Officials Doubt He Was Unaware: Report
content: Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, and top executive at Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed was identified by US spy agencies as an intelligence asset for China.

content: The Air Force Sports Complex, which includes the golf course, is the latest property near the Prime Minister's residence set to be taken back this year, as the land is owned by ministries.

content: During the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, two brothers abruptly left their jobs and came back to the village. Since then, locals noticed a drastic transformation in their financial status and lifestyle.

content: Chief Justice Surya Kant questioned why people still fall for the traps set by fraudsters, despite constant media coverage and ongoing awareness campaigns.

content: Initially, the plan was to model it on parliamentary proceedings, with the government and opposition facing each other and holding a debate in presence of a presiding officer. This has now been changed.

content: "Every year, we pass orders on the issue... For us, it has now become an academic exercise... Our orders are violated more often than they are followed," the bench said, concluding that it is time to "try something new and innovative," the bench said.

content: The relentless police efforts ensured all 17 prisoners who escaped after staging a fake medical emergency and overpowering prison guards, were back behind bars within 43 hours.

content: The minister said that currently, farmers in Karnataka receive around Rs 35 per litre, in addition to the government's incentive of Rs 5 per litre.

title: Wendy Schmidt's $1.4 million oil-cleanup challenge after Deepwater Horizon

title: 'Turn the blade inward': Xi swings the axe again, expels 33 in major CCP purge

title: Spain train tragedy: Glitch, 3 operator errors behind crash that killed 68
content: a computer malfunction knocked out the control system on a 69-km stretch of track . the failure automatically stopped several trains, including an Iryo service and a state-owned Renfe AVE train travelling behind it . instead of requiring the AVE to proceed at a restricted speed, the control centre at Madrid's Atocha station allegedly instructed its driver to resume the journey at normal speed .
